title: FeatureScript desk tidy
description: A desk tidy written in FeatureScript, Onshape’s language for features, and built in this browser by a FeatureScript engine compiled to WebAssembly. Change its size and details, then inspect or download it as STL or STEP.
notes: One FeatureScript feature builds the whole part from Onshape’s standard library: sketches (with engraved text), an extruded plate with filleted corners and rounded or chamfered edges, a vase revolved from a fit spline and shelled, a tower lofted from a square to a circle, a handle swept along an arc, pins in a circular pattern, slots in a linear pattern and counterbored holes, joined into one solid. Its parameters are the feature’s own, read from its precondition; the Handle thickness applies only with a handle. The engine runs Onshape’s FeatureScript and standard library with OpenCascade as its geometry kernel, so results can differ from Onshape’s in places it doesn’t yet match. A rebuild shows in a second or two, and its STL and STEP are ready to download a moment later; the first also downloads the engine (about 9 MB compressed).
